payload.name: Preserve existing facts when updating memories
payload.description: Use when updating an existing memory with new facts: preserve all prior facts, add new ones, or create a separate memory for a distinct activity.
content: When performing UPDATE or MERGE on an existing memory, keep all existing factual content intact; add the new information without deleting or replacing prior facts.
If the new information describes a different activity or event than the memory's current focus, create a separate event memory instead of overwriting the existing one.
When updating the object_text or summary of a memory, ensure it reflects all key facts in the content, not only the most recent one.

solves: When enriching an existing event memory, the agent replaced prior agility-class facts with a later stroll fact, losing a retrievable answer. This skill preserves all previously stored facts during UPDATE/MERGE and separates distinct activities, preventing later queries from missing earlier evidence. Applies to any update to existing memories that adds new temporal or activity information.
